name: early-bird
description: Wakes your Claude usage window early, so the 5-hour limit resets at the time you choose.

resetTime.title: Reset time
resetTime.description: When you want the 5-hour usage window to reset, as HH:MM in your local time (24-hour). The greeting is sent 5 hours before it.

days.title: Days
days.description: Which days to send the greeting.

timer.title: Timer
timer.description: Keep the OS timer installed (systemd on Linux, launchd on macOS, Task Scheduler on Windows). Turn off, then start a session, to remove it.
